brief_item.title: Photonic-CXL池化内存扩展KVCache容量与带宽
brief_item.direction_name: 加速器、内存、存储与AI Fabric
brief_item.core_conclusion: 论文提出用无交换机光纤全互连替代电CXL交换机，形成Photonic-CXL内存池。设计目标是32TB容量、最多16台主机和每主机128GB/s单向带宽，用于减少KVCache驱逐后的重算。
brief_item.mechanism: 装置把池化内存接入vLLM和LMCache层级，优先从共享内存读取KV块。光纤shuffle提供全互连数据面，硬件仿真比较其与电CXL池的延迟，并用服务仿真观察多轮请求的TTFT。
brief_item.result: 在A100、H100和H200系统、8B至405B模型及最长4M Token上下文的重复请求测试中，主机内存读取相对GPU重算最高快100倍。服务仿真中，多轮会话TTFT提升6.6倍，并在300个并发会话下保持平坦。
brief_item.boundary: 32TB、128GB/s和超过50%的延迟下降来自架构仿真，硬件未部署。6.6倍TTFT来自特定驱逐条件的服务仿真，网络竞争、一致性、光故障、软件集成和真实命中率仍未验证。
brief_item.project_relevance: 这为TPN提供池化KV内存基座，先缓解容量与带宽缺口，由调度策略决定放置和传输。评估应拆分驱逐率、池内延迟、TTFT尾部、并发用户和故障恢复。

facts.title: A Photonic-CXL Memory Appliance for Scalable KV Cache Management in LLM Inference
facts.event_hint: Photonic-CXL switch-free shared-memory appliance for large-scale KV caches
facts.problem: LLM KV caches require tens of terabytes at hundreds of GB/s, but GPU HBM, host DRAM, SSD, electrical CXL, and network transfer tiers each trade capacity, bandwidth, latency, or power. Disaggregated prefill/decode further makes KV movement a TTFT bottleneck and cache eviction causes latency cliffs.
facts.mechanism: The Marvell Photonic Fabric Memory Appliance replaces electrical CXL switches with a passive optical-fiber shuffle and switch-free full crossbar, providing shared memory across hosts. The photonic-CXL design targets 32 TB pooled capacity, 128 GB/s unidirectional bandwidth per host, and up to 16 hosts; it is integrated with vLLM/LMCache-style tiers to retrieve KV blocks from pooled memory and avoid eviction-driven recomputation.

evidence.claim: Host-memory KV retrieval reaches up to 100x speedup over GPU recomputation, while SSD retrieval reaches at most 9.7x in the tested configurations.
evidence.value: up to 100x host; up to 9.7x SSD
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 2-3, Characterization and Table I

evidence.claim: The PF Memory Appliance provides 32 TB shared memory across up to 16 hosts with 128 GB/s unidirectional bandwidth per host.
Hardware emulation shows over 50% latency reduction versus electrical CXL switched memory pools.
End-to-end serving simulation improves TTFT by 6.6x for multi-turn conversations and sustains flat TTFT as workload scales to 300 concurrent conversations.
evidence.condition: Photonic Fabric Memory Appliance augmented serving simulation

evidence.claim: The repeated-request characterization covers A100, H100, and H200 systems, LLaMA models from 8B to 405B, and contexts up to 4M tokens.
evidence.condition: 100% cache-hit repeated-request benchmark with vLLM and LMCache

facts.evaluation_context: The paper combines repeated-request characterization on local/cloud A100/H100/H200 systems, emulation of the photonic-CXL appliance, and end-to-end serving simulations. The characterization uses vLLM with LMCache, batch sizes 1/2/8/16/32, contexts up to 4M tokens, and 100% cache-hit conditions; appliance results are emulated/simulated rather than a deployed hardware measurement.
facts.limitations: The 32 TB/128 GB/s appliance and >50% latency reduction are architecture/emulation results, not production deployment evidence. End-to-end 6.6x TTFT is a simulation under specified multi-turn and eviction conditions; network contention, optical fault behavior, CXL coherence overhead, software integration cost, and real workload hit rates are not established. Host-memory speedups depend strongly on model size, context length, batch, PCIe bandwidth, and the no-cache recomputation baseline; SSD can be slower than recomputation in some cases (inference).
facts.project_relevance: This is a hardware substrate for treating KV cache as a pooled, network-adjacent memory resource: it targets capacity-bandwidth gaps before TPN policy decides placement or transfer. For project evaluation, separate cache eviction rate, pooled-memory latency/bandwidth, TTFT tail, concurrent users, and photonic/CXL failure recovery; do not conflate emulated appliance gains with scheduler gains (inference).
